title: In this city, your shadow is alive

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [mysterious] In this city... your shadow is alive.
lines.caption: In this city your shadow is alive

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: It copies everything you do. Well... almost everything.
lines.caption: It copies everything you do Well almost everything

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [excited] It shows how you REALLY feel. Scared? It shakes. Happy? It dances!
lines.caption: It shows how you REALLY feel Scared? It shakes Happy? It dances!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [serious] And shadows have one rule. They can NEVER lie.
lines.caption: And shadows have one rule They can NEVER lie

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [sighs] Which is a big problem... because I lie a lot.
lines.caption: Which is a big problem because I lie a lot

lines.speaker: pickle

lines.caption: Bean! Try my brand new donut! It's pickle flavored!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [forced enthusiasm] Mmm! Wow! It's delicious!
lines.caption: Mmm! Wow! It's delicious!

lines.speaker: dottie

lines.caption: Bean Did you eat my chocolate bar?

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [innocent] What? No! I would never!
lines.caption: What? No! I would never!

lines.speaker: dottie

lines.caption: Your shadow is literally licking its fingers!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [angry] I KNEW it! You owe me TWO chocolate bars!
lines.caption: I KNEW it! You owe me TWO chocolate bars!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [frustrated] That's it! I don't need you anymore! Go away!
lines.caption: That's it! I don't need you anymore! Go away!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [quietly] So... he did.
lines.caption: So he did

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [excited] No shadow means no snitch! I can say anything!
lines.caption: No shadow means no snitch! I can say anything!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [confident] Max! I can fly. I just don't feel like it today.
lines.caption: Max! I can fly I just don't feel like it today

lines.speaker: max
lines.tts: [amazed] Whoa! That's so cool!
lines.caption: Whoa! That's so cool!

lines.speaker: max
lines.tts: [confused] Then why is your shadow over there... flapping its arms and falling on its face?
lines.caption: Then why is your shadow over there flapping its arms and falling on its face?

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [panicked] Oh no. He's telling everyone the truth!
lines.caption: Oh no He's telling everyone the truth!

lines.speaker: bean

lines.caption: And in this city if your shadow isn't back by sunset it's gone Forever

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [furious] You ate the OTHER one too?!
lines.caption: You ate the OTHER one too?!

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [outraged] You HATE my donuts?!
lines.caption: You HATE my donuts?!

lines.speaker: max
lines.tts: [excited] Fly, Bean! FLY!
lines.caption: Fly Bean! FLY!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [breathless] The bridge was going up... and the sun was going down.
lines.caption: The bridge was going up and the sun was going down

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [softly] There he was. At the end of the pier. All alone.
lines.caption: There he was At the end of the pier All alone

lines.speaker: bean

lines.caption: No more lies I promise

lines.speaker: bean

lines.caption: He came back!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [warmly] Aww. I'm so proud of you, Bean.

lines.caption: Dottie doesn't have a shadow

lines.speaker: bean

prompts.playful: Playful, slightly mysterious instrumental cartoon underscore: soft pizzicato strings, celesta and light marimba over a gentle brushed-snare groove at about 100 bpm, quiet and sparse with lots of space for dialogue. Around 45 seconds it slows down and turns soft, wistful and tender: warm music box and felt piano, no drums, gently fading at the end.
